title: Primus Confidential Vault (FHE) on BSC — no unprivileged extraction path
closed_reasons: Aggregator batch settlement (dispatchAggregate / dispatchAggregateCallback) is overridden to keeper-only in UnitasAggregatorConfidentialUpgradeable; live keeper = 0x43A28B8dD1ebc3752ECcfd610d70D5c2BCc18FB6, non-keeper reverts NotKeeper(address).

claim(aggregateId, account) is permissionless but always pays the depositor `account` after zeroing that account's own deposit; an account with no deposit reverts ZeroDeposits / UnexpectedAggregateState.
quit(aggregateId) is self-only (deposits[id][msg.sender]); recoverAggregate and every policy setter are onlyOwner.

finalizeUnshield(requestId, cleartext, proof) is permissionless but reverts InvalidUnshieldRequest for any id not opened by a real unshield, always pays the recorded recipient, and requires FHE.checkSignatures -> Decryption.verifyPublicDecryptionEIP712KMSSignature (threshold 2-of-3 KMS).
unshield(from,to,amount) requires FHE.isAllowed(amount, msg.sender) AND from==msg.sender||isOperator; _update clamps with tryDecrease so no balance can be over-spent or stolen.
FHE ACL allow/allowForDecryption require the caller to already hold the handle (SenderNotAllowed otherwise); ACL/FHEExecutor/Decryption/SpaceBridgeConfig are owner-only.
RestrictedConfidentialConverter can pin esUSDu transfers to whitelisted rails (esUSDu-u live transferRestrictionEnabled()=true).
UnitasRewardPool enterBatch/postPeriod/claimRewardBatch are onlyKeeper; onConfidentialTransferReceived only accepts the reward token.
StakedUSDuV2 (Ethena-lineage ERC4626) share math uses tryDecrease/clamp + MIN_SHARES anti-donation guard + 7d cooldown + blacklist roles; no rounding edge for outsiders.

Batch cadence: mint minAggregateAge 28800s (8h) / deadline 86400s; redeem minAggregateAge 604800s (7d) / deadline 1296000s; reward pool period 28800s (8h). Live batch ids: mint_u 180, mint_usdt 101, redeem_u 9, redeem_usdt 5. Only redeem_u #8 in flight (step 4 RedeemCooldown, healthy).

FHE decryption is centralised: 2-of-3 KMS signers (0x7b0D311DE29c8AC04948a30BecB268F97d23B8ee, 0x91D3D15FE8f3b5fd4b26584FA3912dF3a432848b, 0x708f25bEc3a52748C44727909a6916439d9a08cc) and 2-of-3 Alphatrion signers, all owned/operated under owner 0xEA7Ff99584C1996Bd9E94033b5C7A1Fe37B00d87. The KMS proof is value-bearing, so a 2-key compromise = forged finalizeUnshield = converter drain (classified P, not E-U).

Privileged actors: owner#1 0xEA7Ff99584C1996Bd9E94033b5C7A1Fe37B00d87 (ACL, FHEExecutor, Decryption, SpaceBridgeConfig, eU, esUSDu-u, mint_u, redeem_u, reward pool, ProxyAdmins); owner#2 0x3480B1E2f19D95cdfb8dA3ae40E9C7C500Fe4893 (eUSDT, esUSDu-usdt, mint_usdt, redeem_usdt); aggregator keeper 0x43A28B8dD1ebc3752ECcfd610d70D5c2BCc18FB6; reward-pool keeper 0x70520046798043970955AbF5189c63b11C3Dd3DC.

All stack contracts are verified on Etherscan (chainid 56) and are UUPS / Transparent-upgradeable behind EIP-1967 proxies; the vault proxy 0xe9E8573Bb351da16c6EE7dDaC0cBC70b7f9784AE delegates to UnitasProxy (mintAndStake/redeemAndWithdraw role-gated MINT_CALLER_ROLE/REDEEM_CALLER_ROLE).
caveats: FHE confidentiality + decryption authorisation are centralised (2-of-3 KMS / 2-of-3 Alphatrion, all Primus EOAs); the decryption proof is value-bearing, so a 2-key compromise drains the converters. This is a privileged/insider risk (P), not external-unprivileged (E-U).

The recon's '>$1M user deposits' is not what is on-chain today: the FHE converters back $248,434.55; the remainder of the reported figure is likely cumulative or the Unitas backend ($38.7M TVL), which is not FHE-vault value.

H-O ($248,434.55) is redeemable only via the keeper-driven off-chain Unitas mint/redeem API and, on the redeem route, only after the 7-day sUSDu cooldown; if the keeper halts, the owner must recoverAggregate.
S (~$109 = 0.146737176 BNB at $741.82) is the FHEExecutor prepaid fee balance: refundFee is disabled and only the owner/AlphatrionReward can distribute it; effectively unrecoverable by users.
Reads were taken at BSC block 129,593,000 with an archive RPC (key redacted); prices from DefiLlama at ts 1792881602. Some getters (penaltyRate, converter paused()) revert by design and are not used.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Primus Confidential Vault (FHE) on BSC; all value-moving paths are gated by FHE-ACL handle access, self-ownership, a keeper/owner role, or a 2-of-3 KMS decryption proof — the ~$248,434 of live backing is holder-only (H-O) and the whole stack (including the FHE oracle) is controlled by two Primus EOAs plus one keeper EOA.
